## `neuro.string.normalize`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Returns the String value result of normalizing the string into the normalization form
> named by form as specified in Unicode Standard Annex #15, Unicode Normalization Forms.

## Signatures

```ts
normalize(input: { string: <receiver>; form: "NFC" | "NFD" | "NFKC" | "NFKD"; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
normalize(input: { string: <receiver>; form?: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.normalize` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
